headline: A 2021 executive order from President Biden about the supply chains that bring goods and materials to the United States.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with America's supply chains, the networks that make and move goods and materials to the country. No summary was provided, so its specific directions to federal agencies are not described here.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 24, 2021. No other dates were provided.
